answer: Behavioral spiral tracing. Agents log a yarrow-like branching trace of action sequences; after the fact, a detector scores pairwise behavioral overlap across accounts. Identities whose traces converge on the same rare action path within a short window get flagged as one cluster. Attacker cost: each fake identity must sustain genuinely distinct behavior over many steps, multiplying operational effort per account by the trace length. An onyx marker tags flagged clusters for quarantine.
